props.name: rows
props.description: The rows (client data), used as-is and never mutated. Omit when using `dataSource`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions, in default display order (see `ColumnDef`).

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Stable unique id of a row: a property name or `(row) => string | number`. All row state is keyed by it.

props.name: features
props.description: Opt-in features for this grid (added to the app-wide `createVueGrid({ features })`): `sortingFeature`, `filteringFeature`, `serverDataFeature`, `paginationFeature`, or `allFeatures`. Read once, when the grid is created.

props.name: dataSource
props.description: Server data: called with the current query (sort, filters, search, page) whenever it changes. The grid cancels superseded requests, shows loading and errors, and sorts / filters / pages nothing itself.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Built-in pagination under the grid (server-side with `dataSource`, client-side otherwise).

props.name: statusBar
props.description: A status bar under the grid (status bar feature): rows that pass the filters ("84 of 200 rows"), selected rows, active filters with Clear; `{ summary: ['total'] }` adds the sum and average of those columns over the selected rows. `#status-bar` replaces its content.

props.name: saveCell
props.description: Saves an edited cell (editing feature), after `cell-edit`: return a Promise and the cell shows it saving; a rejection keeps the editor open with the error's message. Without it, `cell-edit` alone carries the change.

props.name: rangeSelection
props.description: Cell-range selection (range selection feature), as in a spreadsheet: drag across cells or Shift+click to select a block, Shift+arrows to extend it, Ctrl/⌘+A for every cell, Esc to clear; Ctrl/⌘+C copies it. Bind `v-model:range` to read or set it.

props.name: undoLimit
props.description: How many changes undo remembers (editing feature): each edit, checkbox flip or paste is one. Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y / Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z redo; `0` turns undo off. Default `100`.

props.name: messages
props.description: Built-in text (translations, wording), over `createVueGrid({ messages })`.

props.name: parts
props.description: Built-in parts to leave out (`{ progressBar: false }`), over `createVueGrid({ parts })`.

props.name: sortMode
props.description: `controlled` (default): a header click only updates `v-model:sort` (sort on the server or in your own code). `client`: the grid sorts the rows itself. Ignored with `dataSource`.

props.name: filterMode
props.description: `client` (default): the grid filters its rows. `controlled`: it only emits `update:filters`.

props.name: filterRow
props.description: Show the filter row: an input under each filterable column's header.

props.name: filterStorage
props.description: Persist the filter model (`string` = localStorage key).

props.name: noMatchText
props.description: Shown when filters hide every row. Default: `messages.noMatch`, else `No rows match the current filters.`

props.name: selectable
props.description: A selection column: `true` = multi-select (with select-all), `'single'` = one row.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: `cascade` (default): selecting a parent selects its children. `independent`: rows alone.

props.name: isRowSelectable
props.description: Rows that can't be selected get a disabled checkbox.

props.name: pruneSelection
props.description: Drop selected keys whose rows are no longer in the data (after a reload, a delete, a new server page). Default: keys are kept, so a selection can span server pages.

props.name: subRows
props.description: Synchronous child rows of a row: shown in a nested sub-grid when expanded.

props.name: loadSubRows
props.description: Lazy child rows, loaded on first expand (cached, with loading / error / retry).

props.name: hasSubRows
props.description: With `loadSubRows`: which rows get an expander (default: every row).

props.name: rowExpandable
props.description: With a `#detail` slot: which rows can expand to show it (default: every row).

props.name: rowClickable
props.description: Pointer cursor on rows (`row-click` is emitted either way).

props.name: rowClass
props.description: Extra classes for a row.

props.name: rowAttrs
props.description: Extra attributes for each data row, such as test hooks (`{ 'data-test': ... }`).

props.name: rowReorder
props.description: Rows can be moved: a handle column to drag them by, and Alt+↑ / Alt+↓. The grid emits `row-move`; your handler moves the row (`moveRow`). Needs the row reorder feature.

props.name: cellAttrs
props.description: Extra attributes for each cell of a data row, such as test hooks.

props.name: highlightedRows
props.description: Keys of rows to highlight (e.g. the row being edited).

props.name: flash
props.description: Briefly highlight cells whose value changes (live data, enrichment). Columns can override.

props.name: virtual
props.description: Virtual scrolling: only the rows in view render. Rows share one height (`rowHeight`, px) and the grid needs a bounded height. Needs the virtual scrolling feature.

props.name: virtualColumns
props.description: Column virtualization: only the columns in view (plus `overscan`) render cells, besides the pinned ones and the checkbox. `true` or `{ overscan, width }`. Needs the column virtualization feature.

props.name: storage
props.description: Persist column state (order, hidden, pins, widths): a localStorage key or your own storage.

props.name: pinnedMaxShare
props.description: Pinned columns scroll like the others while together they'd take more than this share of the grid's width (a phone, a narrow panel); pinned again once there's room. `false`: always pinned. Column pinning feature.

props.name: renderers
props.description: Renderers usable by name in this grid (merged over the app-wide ones).

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for number / date renderers (default: the plugin's, else the browser's).

props.name: currency
props.description: Default ISO 4217 currency for currency renderers.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA time zone for date renderers and date filters.

props.name: density
props.description: Cell padding scale.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a progress bar and sets `aria-busy` (server data sets it by itself).

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when there are no rows. Default: `messages.empty`, else `No data to show.`

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the grid.

props.name: ui
props.description: Extra classes per part (`root`, `header`, `headerCell`, `row`, `cell`, `subgrid`, `detail`, `empty`), e.g. Tailwind utilities.

props.name: contextMenu
props.description: Right-click menu items for a body cell. Return `null`/`[]` to keep the browser's menu.

props.name: headerMenu
props.description: Header right-click menu: `true` = built-in items (sort, pin, move, hide, reset), `false` = off, or a function that receives the built-in items and returns the items to show.

props.name: pinnedTopRows
props.description: Extra rows above the body, not part of the data (row pinning feature).

props.name: pinnedBottomRows
props.description: Extra rows below the body, not part of the data (row pinning feature).

props.name: totals
props.description: A totals row with each column's `aggregate` (aggregation feature): `true` / `'bottom'` sticks it to the bottom, `'top'` under the header.

props.name: totalsLabel
props.description: The totals row's label, in its first column (unless that column has an aggregate). Default: `messages.total`, else `Total`.

props.name: aggregates
props.description: Totals row values by column key, instead of computing them (e.g. totals from a server).

props.name: groupsExpanded
props.description: Groups start expanded (row grouping feature). Default: collapsed.

props.name: multiSort
props.description: Multi-column sort (sorting feature): Shift-click (or Shift+Enter) on a header adds it as the next key, Shift-click again turns it descending, then removes it. `v-model:sorts` holds every key, `v-model:sort` the first; server queries get `sorts` too.

models.name: sort
models.description: Sort state: a header click cycles asc → desc → none. Header UI needs the sorting feature.

models.name: sorts
models.description: Every sort key, the first one first (`multi-sort`). `sort` is the first of them.

models.name: columnState
models.description: Column order, hidden columns, runtime pins and resized widths (persisted with `storage`).

models.name: expanded
models.description: Keys of expanded rows (sub-grids and detail rows).

models.name: selected
models.description: Keys of selected rows. Needs the selection feature.

models.name: filters
models.description: Column filters and quick search: `{ columns: Record<key, ColumnFilter>, search }`. Needs the filtering feature.

models.name: page
models.description: Current page (1-based); resets to 1 when sort or filters change. Needs the pagination feature.

models.name: pageSize
models.description: Rows per page. Needs the pagination feature.

models.name: pinnedRows
models.description: Top-level rows pinned above / below the body, by key: `{ top, bottom }`. Needs the row pinning feature.

models.name: groupBy
models.description: Column keys to group the rows by, outermost first (`['region', 'status']`, or one key). Group rows show the value, the row count and the columns' aggregates. Needs the row grouping feature.

models.name: selectAllMatching
models.description: Server data: every row matching the query is selected, not just the loaded ones (set from the "Select all N rows" banner; ends when filters change or a row is unticked). Act on the query then, not on `selected`. Needs the selection feature.

models.name: selectedGroups
models.description: Server data with row grouping: groups selected by query, by their paths, without loading their rows (a group's checkbox). Act on these with `selected` and the filters. Ends when the filters or the grouping change. Needs the selection and row grouping features.

models.name: range
models.description: The selected block of cells (`range-selection`): `{ start, end }` corner cells by row key and column key, or null. One cell alone is no range. Needs the range selection feature.

events.name: query-change
events.description: The combined query (sort, filters, search, page) — on mount and whenever it changes.

events.name: load-error
events.description: A `dataSource` call failed. The grid shows an error with Retry, above the rows from before if any.

events.name: row-click
events.description: A row was clicked (not on a link, button or input inside it, nor a `clickable` column).

events.name: cell-click
events.description: A cell of a `clickable: true` column was clicked.

events.name: cell-action
events.description: A renderer emitted an action (buttons, toggles, menus, edit, copy).

events.name: cell-edit
events.description: A cell was edited (editing feature): update your data with `value`. The grid doesn't.

events.name: cells-paste
events.description: A paste finished (range selection + editing): every changed cell (each also a `cell-edit`), the cells left alone and why, and the `save-cell` calls that failed.

events.name: cells-fill
events.description: A fill finished (the fill handle, Ctrl/⌘+D): every changed cell (each also a `cell-edit`, `source: 'fill'`), the cells left alone and why, and the saves that failed.

events.name: cells-replace
events.description: A replace in the find bar finished: every changed cell (each also a `cell-edit`, `source: 'replace'`), the cells left alone and why, and the saves that failed.

events.name: cells-clear
events.description: Cells were cleared (Delete / Backspace, or Ctrl/⌘+X after copying them): every changed cell (each also a `cell-edit`, `source: 'clear'` / `'cut'`), the cells left alone and why, and the saves that failed.

events.name: row-move
events.description: A row was dragged or moved with Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ (row reorder feature): move it in your rows.

events.name: context-action
events.description: An item of the body-cell context menu was chosen.

events.name: header-action
events.description: A custom item of the header menu was chosen (built-in items act by themselves).

events.name: copy
events.description: Rows or a cell were copied to the clipboard (export feature: `copyRows()`, Ctrl/⌘+C).

slots.name: cell-<key>
slots.scope: { row: T; value: unknown; rowKey: RowKey; rowIndex: number; depth: number; column: ColumnDef<T> }
slots.description: A column's body cell, replacing its renderer: `#cell-<key>`.

slots.name: total-<key>
slots.scope: { value: unknown; column: ColumnDef<T>; group?: RowGroup<T> }
slots.description: A column's cell in the totals row and in group rows (aggregation, row grouping); `group` in group rows.

slots.name: group-<key>
slots.scope: { value: unknown; count: number; rows: readonly T[]; column: ColumnDef<T>; group: RowGroup<T> }
slots.description: The value of a group row grouped by this column (row grouping feature): `#group-<key>`.

slots.name: detail
slots.scope: { row: T; rowKey: RowKey; depth: number }
slots.description: Expandable detail row under a row: any content, even another grid.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Shown when there are no rows.

slots.name: no-match
slots.description: Shown when filters hide every row, instead of the message and its Clear filters button.

slots.name: load-error
slots.scope: { error: unknown; retry: () => Promise<void>; stale: boolean }
slots.description: A failed server request (server data): `stale` when the rows from before stay on screen (the notice above them), else in place of the rows. `retry()` asks again.

slots.name: select-all-banner
slots.scope: { total: number; page: number; all: boolean; selectAll: () => void; clearSelection: () => void }
slots.description: Selection with server data: the "Select all N rows" banner.

slots.name: status-bar
slots.description: The status bar's content (status bar feature): replaces the counts and the summary.

slots.name: loading
slots.description: Shown while loading with no rows yet.

slots.name: sub-rows-loading
slots.description: Shown while a row's lazy children load.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.scope: { columns: readonly ColumnDef<T>[]; columnState: ColumnState; setColumnState: (state: ColumnState) => void; filters: FilterState; setFilters: (state: FilterState) => void; clearFilters: () => void; activeFilterCount: number; selected: readonly RowKey[]; selectedCount: number; selectedGroups: GroupPath[]; selectAllMatching: boolean; clearSelection: () => void; openFind: (options?: { replace?: boolean; text?: string }) => void; undo: () => Promise<boolean>; redo: () => Promise<boolean>; canUndo: boolean; canRedo: boolean }
slots.description: Above the grid: put a search box, column menu, filter summary or batch actions here.

methods.name: scrollToTop
methods.description: Scrolls the grid back to its first row.

methods.name: scrollToRow
methods.description: Scrolls a row (top-level or nested, also in virtual mode) into view.

methods.name: scrollToColumn
methods.description: Scrolls a column into view sideways (with `virtual-columns`, renders it first).

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expands every expandable row (sub-grids and detail rows) that passes the filters.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Collapses every row.

methods.name: setColumnState
methods.description: Replaces the column state (order, hidden, pins, widths), and saves it with `storage`.

methods.name: patchLoadedRows
methods.description: Applies field patches to lazily loaded child rows (`loadSubRows`), which the grid caches and the app can't reach. Top-level and synchronous `subRows` data belong to the app: update them there (assign fields on reactive rows, or use `patchRows`). Returns the number of rows patched.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Replaces the filter model (also persisted with `filter-storage`).

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Removes every column filter and the search.

methods.name: openFilter
methods.description: Opens a column's filter popover.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Re-runs the `dataSource` with the current query; lazily loaded child rows load again too.

methods.name: reloadSubRows
methods.description: Forgets lazily loaded child rows (one row's, or all): expanded rows load them again.

methods.name: pinRow
methods.description: Pins a top-level row above or below the body, or unpins it (`null`). Row pinning feature.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears the selection, "all matching rows" included. Selection feature.

methods.name: getCsv
methods.description: The rows as CSV text: the filtered, sorted rows, visible columns, raw values. Export feature.

methods.name: exportCsv
methods.description: Downloads the rows as a CSV file (`filename`, default `export.csv`; UTF-8 with a BOM). Export feature.

methods.name: getXlsx
methods.description: The rows as an Excel workbook (.xlsx): typed cells (numbers, dates, booleans), number formats from the columns' renderers, a bold frozen header. The writer loads on demand. Export feature.

methods.name: exportXlsx
methods.description: Downloads the rows as an Excel file (`filename`, default `export.xlsx`). Export feature.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the rows as a table (the browser's print dialog): the filtered, sorted rows on every page (not just those in view), as the cells show them, the header repeated on each printed page, numbers right-aligned, the totals in bold. Resolves when printing is over. Export feature.

methods.name: copyRows
methods.description: Copies rows to the clipboard as tab-separated text (pastes as cells into spreadsheets): the selected rows by default, as displayed, no header. Resolves `false` if nothing was copied. Export feature.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Opens the editor of a cell (editing feature), if the column is `editable` for that row and the row is on screen. Returns whether it opened.

methods.name: stopEdit
methods.description: Closes the open editor: saves its value, or with `cancel` drops it. Editing feature.

methods.name: selectRange
methods.description: Selects a block of cells (`null` clears it), as `v-model:range` does. Range selection feature, with `range-selection`.

methods.name: getRangeValues
methods.description: The selected range's raw values, row by row (`[]` without a range). Range selection feature.

methods.name: copyRange
methods.description: Copies the selected range as tab-separated text, as the cells show it (Ctrl/⌘+C does the same). Resolves `false` without a range. Range selection feature.

methods.name: pasteText
methods.description: Pastes tab-separated text (what spreadsheets copy) into the editable cells from the selected range's top-left cell, as Ctrl/⌘+V does; a range a whole number of blocks in size is filled. Resolves the `cells-paste` event, or `null` with nowhere to paste. Range selection and editing features.

methods.name: fillDown
methods.description: Fills the selected range down from its top row, as Ctrl/⌘+D does (the fill handle's rules: one value repeats). Resolves the `cells-fill` event, or `null` without a range of two or more rows. Range selection and editing features.

methods.name: openFind
methods.description: Opens the find bar (Ctrl/⌘+F in the grid; `replace: true` also shows the replace row, as Ctrl/⌘+H does), searching the selected range if there is one, else every cell. Range selection feature (replacing needs the editing feature too).

methods.name: closeFind
methods.description: Closes the find bar; the current match becomes the selected cell.

methods.name: clearRange
methods.description: Clears the selected range's editable cells (else the selected cell's), as Delete / Backspace do: blank text, no number or date, an unticked checkbox. Resolves the `cells-clear` event, or `null` with nothing selected. Range selection and editing features.

methods.name: cutRange
methods.description: Copies the selected cells, then clears them (Ctrl/⌘+X). Range selection and editing features.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last change made in the grid (an edit, a checkbox, a whole paste): each cell gets its value back through `cell-edit` (`source: 'undo'`) and `save-cell`, as Ctrl/⌘+Z does. Cells changed since by something else are left alone. Resolves whether anything changed. Editing feature.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redoes the last undone change (Ctrl+Y, Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z). Editing feature.

methods.name: canUndo
methods.description: Whether there's a change to undo (for your own buttons; reactive).

methods.name: canRedo
methods.description: Whether there's an undone change to redo (for your own buttons; reactive).

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Forgets every change (e.g. after saving or reloading).

column.name: key
column.description: Unique, stable column id. Also used for sort state, column state and slot names.

column.name: header
column.description: Header text (default: the key).

column.name: headerTooltip
column.description: Tooltip on the header cell.

column.name: field
column.description: Dot path into the row, e.g. `user.address.city`. Defaults to `key`.

column.name: value
column.description: Computes the cell value; wins over `field`.

column.name: renderer
column.description: A renderer definition (`currencyRenderer`), a registered renderer name, or a component. Defaults to `text`.

column.name: rendererOptions
column.description: Options of the column's renderer, typed against it (merged over the renderer's defaults).

column.name: width
column.description: Any CSS grid track size. Defaults to `auto`.

column.name: minWidth
column.description: Lower bound; combined with `width` into `minmax(minWidth, width)`, and the resize minimum.

column.name: maxWidth
column.description: Upper bound when the user resizes the column (column resizing feature).

column.name: resizable
column.description: Can the user resize this column (column resizing feature)? Default `true`.

column.name: group
column.description: Header group label (column groups feature): adjacent visible columns with the same `group` share one header cell above their own headers.

column.name: align
column.description: Cell and header alignment (default: the renderer's, e.g. `end` for numbers, else `start`).

column.name: sortable
column.description: A sort button in the header (sorting feature). Client sorting needs `sort-mode="client"`.

column.name: sortValue
column.description: The value client sorting compares (default: the renderer's sort value, else the cell value).

column.name: sortFn
column.description: A full comparator for client sorting; wins over `sortValue`.

column.name: pinned
column.description: Initial pin side (the header menu can change it at runtime unless `pinnable: false`).

column.name: pinnable
column.description: Can the user pin/unpin it from the header menu? Default `true`.

column.name: hidden
column.description: Initial visibility (column state wins once it exists).

column.name: hideable
column.description: Can the user hide it from the column menu? Default `true`.

column.name: reorderable
column.description: Can the user move it? Default `true`.

column.name: clickable
column.description: Cell click emits `cell-click` instead of `row-click`.

column.name: filterable
column.description: Show a filter for this column (funnel in the header, and an input in the filter row).

column.name: filter
column.description: Filter type — default from the renderer (number, date, boolean, set for status/chip, else text) — or options.

column.name: filterValue
column.description: Value used for filtering (default: the cell value).

column.name: filterFn
column.type: (row: T, filter: ColumnFilter, value: unknown) => boolean
column.description: Custom predicate; replaces the built-in matching for this column.

column.name: filterComponent
column.description: Custom filter UI (popover), receives `modelValue` / emits `update:modelValue` with a filter.

column.name: searchable
column.description: Include in the quick search. Default `true` for visible columns.

column.name: flash
column.description: Briefly highlight the cell when its value changes (overrides the grid's `flash` prop). `'direction'`: green when a number goes up, red when it goes down.

column.name: aggregate
column.description: The column's value in the totals row (aggregation feature): `'sum' | 'avg' | 'min' | 'max'` over the cell values (empty values skipped), `'count'` of rows, or a function of the values and the rows. Shown with the column's renderer (`count` as a plain number).

column.name: groupable
column.description: The header menu offers Group by / Ungroup for this column (row grouping feature). Any column can be grouped through `v-model:group-by`; this only adds the menu items.

column.name: groupValue
column.description: The value rows are grouped by (row grouping feature), e.g. `(row) => row.placedAt.slice(0, 7)` for months. Default: the cell value, shown with the column's renderer; a `groupValue` is shown as text (or with the `#group-<key>` slot).

column.name: exportValue
column.description: The value exports and copying use (export feature), e.g. a plain id for a link or an object. Wins over the cell value and the renderer's text.

column.name: exportable
column.description: Included in CSV exports and copied rows (export feature)? Default `true`; set `false` on action columns.

column.name: editable
column.description: Cells can be edited in place (editing feature): `true`, or per row. Double-click, Enter or F2 on a focused cell, or typing, opens the editor; the grid emits `cell-edit` and your handler updates the data (the grid never changes rows itself).

column.name: editor
column.description: The editor (editing feature): `text`, `number`, `date`, `datetime`, `select`, `checkbox`, or your own component (`CellEditorProps`). Default from the renderer: numbers and money → number, dates → date, booleans → checkbox, status / chip → select, else text.

column.name: editorOptions
column.description: Options of the editor: the choices of a select, a number's `min` / `max`, a `placeholder`.

column.name: validate
column.type: (value: unknown, row: T) => string | null | undefined | void
column.description: Checks an edited value before it is saved (editing feature): return an error message to keep the editor open with it, or nothing to accept the value.

column.name: cellClass
column.description: Extra classes for the column's body cells (or a function of the row).

column.name: headerClass
column.description: Extra classes for the column's header cell.

features.description: Aggregates and the totals row: columns with an `aggregate` (`sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`, `count` or a function) and `totals` (`true` / `'bottom'` or `'top'`) show a sticky totals row over the rows that pass the filters, on every page. `aggregates` supplies the values instead (e.g. from a server). Without it, `aggregate` and `totals` are ignored.

Your own attributes on rows and cells (`row-attrs`, `cell-attrs`), such as test hooks: `:row-attrs="({ rowIndex }) => ({ 'data-test': `row-${rowIndex}` })"`. Each gets the row, its key and its position as shown (cells also the column and its position). The grid's own attributes (role, ARIA, `tabindex`, classes, styles, its `data-*` hooks) and `on…` handlers are left alone.

Grouped column headers: give columns a `group` and adjacent visible columns of the same group get one header cell spanning them, in a sticky row above the column headers. Groups follow reordering, hiding and pinning (a pin boundary splits a group). Without it, `group` is ignored.

Pinned columns: `pinned: 'left' | 'right'` columns stay put (sticky) while the grid scrolls sideways, with edge shadows; runtime pins from the header menu (Pin left / Pin right / Unpin) are kept in `v-model:column-state` and persisted with `storage`. While the pinned columns would take more than `pinned-max-share` of the grid's width (half, by default), they scroll like the others. Without it, pins are ignored.

Column reordering: drag a header (mouse, pen, touch), Alt+←/→ on a focused header, and the header menu's Move left / Move right. Columns opt out with `reorderable: false`. The order is part of `v-model:column-state` and persisted with `storage`; `<VGridColumnMenu>` works without it.

Column resizing: drag a header's edge (mouse, pen, touch), use ←/→ on the focused edge (Alt+Shift+←/→ on a header with keyboard navigation), or double-click the edge to fit the content. `minWidth` / `maxWidth` bound it; columns opt out with `resizable: false`. Widths are kept in `columnState.widths` and persisted with `storage`. The header menu gains Fit width / Reset width.

Column virtualization (`virtual-columns`): for grids with many columns, only the columns in view (plus `overscan`) render their cells, alongside the pinned ones and the checkbox. Every column keeps its place in the CSS grid, so widths, pinning, resizing and sub-grids work as before. Columns sized by their content (`auto`, `min-content`) get a definite width while it's on (`{ width: '10rem' }`). Combines with `virtual` (rows) for large sheets both ways.

Column visibility: `hidden: true` columns, `columnState.hidden` (persisted with `storage`), the header menu's Hide column item and `<VGridColumnMenu>`'s checkboxes. Columns opt out with `hideable: false`. Without it, every column shows.

CSV and Excel export and copying: `grid.exportCsv()` downloads the filtered, sorted rows as a CSV file, `grid.getCsv()` returns the text, `grid.exportXlsx()` / `grid.getXlsx()` write an Excel workbook with typed cells (the writer loads on demand), `grid.print()` prints every matching row as a table with the header on each page, `grid.copyRows()` copies rows as tab-separated text, and Ctrl/⌘+C copies the selected rows, else the focused cell, as displayed. Columns can set `exportValue` and `exportable: false`. Without it those methods only warn.

Filtering: header funnels with typed filter popovers on `filterable` columns, the filter row, `<VGridSearch>`, the filter items of the header menu, `v-model:filters` and filter persistence. The popover body and the filter-row editors load on demand (own chunks).

Keyboard navigation (the ARIA grid pattern): the grid is one tab stop, arrow keys / Home / End / PageUp / PageDown move between cells, Enter activates a cell's control, Space selects a row, →/← expand and collapse, Alt+←/→ move a column, ContextMenu / Shift+F10 open the cell menu. Without it the grid is an ARIA `table`: its own controls (sort buttons, expanders, checkboxes, filter buttons) sit in the normal Tab order instead.

Context menus: the built-in header menu (sort, filter, pin, move, hide, reset, your own items via `header-menu`) and body-cell menus (`context-menu`), opened by right-click, the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10. Without it the browser's own menu shows. The standalone `<VGridMenu>` and the `actions-menu` renderer don't need it.

Built-in pagination: the `pagination` prop and `v-model:page` / `v-model:page-size`. Pages the client rows, or asks the `dataSource` for pages. The pager loads on demand (own chunk). Not needed for the standalone `<VGridPagination>` component.

Row grouping: `v-model:group-by="['region', 'status']"` groups the rows by those columns into collapsible group rows with their value, row count and the aggregates of columns with an `aggregate`. Columns with `groupable: true` get Group by / Ungroup items in the header menu. Without it, `group-by` is ignored.

Pinned rows: `v-model:pinned-rows` (`{ top, bottom }` row keys), `pinned-top-rows` / `pinned-bottom-rows` (extra rows that aren't in the data) and the `pinRow()` method. Pinned rows stay in view (sticky) under the header or at the bottom while the body scrolls, and aren't filtered, sorted or paged. Without it, those options are ignored.

Row reordering (`row-reorder`): a handle column to drag rows by (mouse, pen, touch), and Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ on a row's cells. Rows move among their siblings (a nested row stays under its parent). Controlled, like editing: the grid emits `row-move` and your handler moves the row (`moveRow(rows, event)`). The handles are off while rows are sorted or grouped.

Row selection: the `selectable` prop (multi or single), `v-model:selected`, `selection-mode` (cascade through sub-grids), `is-row-selectable`, Space on a row, shift-click (or Shift+Space) for a range, the select-all checkbox, `prune-selection`, and with server data a "select all N matching rows" banner (`v-model:select-all-matching`; it loads on demand, its own chunk).
Server data: the `dataSource` prop. The grid sends sort, filters and page to your function, cancels superseded requests, and shows loading, error and retry states.

Row grouping with server data: with `group-by` and a `data-source`, the query carries `groupBy` and `groupPath`, the server answers with groups (value, count, aggregates), and each group's contents load when it expands. A group's checkbox selects it by query (`v-model:selected-groups`), without loading its rows. Needs the row grouping and server data features too. Without it, a grouped server grid groups only the rows it has loaded.
Sorting: the sort button on `sortable` column headers, the sort items of the header menu and, with `sort-mode="client"`, sorting the rows in the browser.

A status bar under the grid (`status-bar`): how many rows pass the filters ("84 of 200 rows"), how many are selected, how many filters are on (with Clear), and with `{ summary: ['total'] }` the sum and average of those columns over the selected rows, as the cells show them. The `#status-bar` slot replaces its content. Its component loads on demand (own chunk).
Sub-grids: nested child rows in a CSS `subgrid`, from `sub-rows` (synchronous) or `load-sub-rows` (lazy, cached, with loading / error / retry). Detail rows (`#detail` slot) don't need it.

Virtual scrolling: `:virtual="{ rowHeight, overscan?, detailHeight? }"` renders only the rows in view (plus `overscan`), so tens of thousands of rows stay fast — sub-grids and detail rows included, inside the same CSS grid / subgrid layout. Without it, `virtual` is ignored and every row renders.

renderers.name: text
renderers.description: Text, the default renderer (the only one `<VGrid>` bundles): ellipsis, line clamp, tone, badge, icon, secondary text, copy button.

options.name: ellipsis
options.description: Single line with ellipsis (full text in a tooltip).

options.name: lines
options.description: Clamp to N lines.

options.name: maxWidth
options.description: CSS max width of the text, e.g. `'16rem'`: longer text wraps or, with `ellipsis`, is cut.

options.name: preserveNewlines
options.description: Keep line breaks in the value (`white-space: pre-line`).

options.name: tooltip
options.description: `true` = value as tooltip; a function computes it.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

options.name: tone
options.description: Colour of the text (`success`, `danger`, `warning`, `info`, `neutral`, `accent`), or `(value, row) => tone`.

options.name: toneMode
options.description: `text` (default) colours the text; `fill` colours the badge-like background.

options.name: bold
options.description: Bold text, for every row or `(value, row) => boolean`.

options.name: secondary
options.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. a half-time score: `2:1 (1:0)`.

options.name: badge
options.description: Badge before (default) or after the value.

options.name: badgePosition
options.description: Where `badge` goes: `start` (default, before the value) or `end`.

options.name: icon
options.description: Icon before the value, e.g. `{ icon: BellIcon, tone: 'warning', label: 'Notify' }`.

options.name: copyable
options.description: Adds a copy-to-clipboard button; emits `copy` with the copied text.

options.name: copyValue
options.description: What gets copied (default: the displayed text).

renderers.name: toggle-text
renderers.description: Text that toggles a highlight when clicked. Emits `toggle` (with `clickable`).

options.name: clickable
options.description: When true, the text is a button that emits action `toggle`.

options.name: highlighted
options.description: Shown as switched on (highlighted, `aria-pressed`), e.g. `(v, row) => row.starred`.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

renderers.name: number
renderers.description: Locale-formatted numbers. With `clickable`, a link-style button that emits `click`.

options.name: format
options.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options, e.g. `{ maximumFractionDigits: 0 }` or `{ style: 'percent' }`.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

options.name: clickable
options.description: Renders the number as a link-style button that emits `click` (drill-down).

renderers.name: signed-number
renderers.description: Numbers that always show their sign (+ / −). With `clickable`, emits `click`.

options.name: signed
options.description: Always show the sign (`+3`, `−2`). Default `true` for `signed-number`; `false` formats like `number`.

options.name: format
options.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options, e.g. `{ maximumFractionDigits: 0 }` or `{ style: 'percent' }`.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

options.name: clickable
options.description: Renders the number as a link-style button that emits `click` (drill-down).

renderers.name: currency
renderers.description: Money in a fixed or per-row currency (default: the grid's `currency`). With `clickable`, emits `click`.

options.name: currency
options.description: ISO 4217 code, or derived from the row. Defaults to the grid context currency.

options.name: format
options.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options, e.g. `{ maximumFractionDigits: 0 }` or `{ style: 'percent' }`.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

options.name: clickable
options.description: Renders the number as a link-style button that emits `click` (drill-down).

renderers.name: change
renderers.description: A rise or fall: the value with an up / down arrow, green or red.

options.name: direction

options.name: currency
options.description: Format as currency (`true` = context currency).

options.name: iconOnly
options.description: Only the arrow (the value becomes its accessible label).

options.name: format
options.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options, e.g. `{ maximumFractionDigits: 0 }` or `{ style: 'percent' }`.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

options.name: clickable
options.description: Renders the number as a link-style button that emits `click` (drill-down).

renderers.name: date

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

renderers.name: datetime

options.name: milliseconds

options.name: twoLines

options.name: format

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

options.name: nullLabel

options.name: display

options.name: falseIcon

renderers.name: status
renderers.description: A coloured status badge (tone from a map, a function or a constant). With `clickable`, emits `click`.

options.name: dot
options.description: A coloured dot before the label. Default `true`; `false` hides it.

options.name: variant
options.description: `soft` (default, tinted), `solid` (filled) or `outline`.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown when the value is empty.

options.name: clickable
options.description: Badge becomes a button that emits `click`.

renderers.description: A safe link (http(s), mailto, tel only), or a `<RouterLink>` with `to` when vue-router is installed.

options.name: href
options.description: The URL, from the value and row (default: the value). Only http(s), mailto and tel are linked; wins over `to`.

options.name: to
options.description: Router location; rendered with `<RouterLink>` when vue-router is installed, else as an href.

options.name: label
options.description: Link text (default: the value).

options.name: target
options.description: `_blank` opens a new tab (with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`).

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Hover text of the link.

renderers.name: icon
renderers.description: An icon component, fixed or picked per row.

options.description: Static icon component.

options.name: iconFor

options.name: show
options.description: Show the icon for this row (default: always). A hidden icon keeps its space, so columns stay aligned.

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name and tooltip. Without one the icon is decorative.

options.name: tone
options.description: Icon colour, or `(value, row) => tone`.

renderers.name: json

options.name: dialogTitle

renderers.name: json-tree

options.name: collapseAt
options.description: Nodes deeper than this start collapsed. Default 1.

options.name: maxDepth
options.description: Deeper nodes are summarised (“3 items”) instead of expanded. Default unlimited.

options.name: parseNested
options.description: String values that contain JSON are shown as nested trees.

options.name: collapsed

options.name: emptyText
